Name: Clip Mode
Description: Selects whether the soft clipping effect is applied above or below the specified threshold.

Flubs.Name: AboveThreshold
Flubs.Description: Applies soft clipping to values above the threshold, gently compressing high values toward the threshold.

Flubs.Name: BelowThreshold
Flubs.Description: Applies soft clipping to values below the threshold, gently compressing low values toward the threshold.

Name: Threshold
Description: Sets the value at which soft clipping begins. Values above or below this threshold (depending on mode) will be affected.

Name: Softness
Description: Controls the smoothness of the transition at the threshold. Higher values create a more gradual, less abrupt clipping effect.

Name: Clipping
Description: Adjusts the overall strength of the clipping effect, determining how much values are compressed toward the threshold.
